title: Randomized decision tree error probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet, let $\alpha$ be a label type with decidable equality, let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with possible error, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f\colon(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. The error probability is the expectation over the seed law and the independent product input law $\pi$ of the indicator that the selected tree's output differs from $f$ on the input.
hypotheses_covered: Randomized decision tree with a finite, nonempty seed space and seed law
